        "contents": "\n# ULTRATERRESTRIAL RESEARCH PLATFORM DESIGN SYSTEM\n\n\u003e **Last Updated**: August 9, 2025  \n\u003e **Version**: 2.0  \n\u003e **Status**: Production Ready  \n\n## Overview\n\nComplete design system for the Ultraterrestrial Research Platform, featuring authentic vintage document styling, classified material presentation, and immersive research interfaces.\n\n---\n\n# Core Design Philosophy\n\nThe design system creates an authentic research atmosphere combining:\n- **Historical Accuracy**: Based on real declassified documents\n- **Information Hierarchy**: Clear classification and content organization  \n- **Immersive Experience**: Vintage textures, aging effects, and period-appropriate styling\n- **Accessibility**: Semantic markup with screen reader support\n- **Modularity**: Composable components for flexible layouts\n\n---\n\n# Component Architecture\n\n## Research UI Components (&#96;/research-ui/&#96;)\nSpecialized document presentation components for UAP/UFO research materials.\n\n### Document Foundation\n- **VintageDocumentCard**: Base container with classification system\n- **ClassificationBadge**: Security level indicators (Unclassified → Top Secret)\n- **TopSecretBanner**: Full-width classification headers\n\n### Specialized Documents  \n- **IncidentReportCard**: UFO sighting and encounter reports\n- **PersonnelFileCard**: Military/civilian personnel documentation\n- **TechnicalDiagramDocument**: Technical blueprints and schematics\n- **HandwrittenNote**: Personal annotations and marginalia\n\n### Visual Elements\n- **Polaroid**: Vintage photograph presentation\n- **DistressedPhoto**: Aged/damaged photograph effects\n- **TypedParagraph**: Typewriter-style text blocks\n\n### Interactive Components\n- **DocumentLibrary**: Searchable document collection\n- **CaseFileFolder**: Expandable file organization\n- **SpyFilesArchiveViewer**: Archive browsing interface\n\n---\n\n# DYSTOPIAN UFO         "originalContents": "\n# ULTRATERRESTRIAL RESEARCH PLATFORM DESIGN SYSTEM\n\n\u003e **Last Updated**: August 9, 2025  \n\u003e **Version**: 2.0  \n\u003e **Status**: Production Ready  \n\n## Overview\n\nComplete design system for the Ultraterrestrial Research Platform, featuring authentic vintage document styling, classified material presentation, and immersive research interfaces.\n\n---\n\n# Core Design Philosophy\n\nThe design system creates an authentic research atmosphere combining:\n- **Historical Accuracy**: Based on real declassified documents\n- **Information Hierarchy**: Clear classification and content organization  \n- **Immersive Experience**: Vintage textures, aging effects, and period-appropriate styling\n- **Accessibility**: Semantic markup with screen reader support\n- **Modularity**: Composable components for flexible layouts\n\n---\n\n# Component Architecture\n\n## Research UI Components (&#96;/research-ui/&#96;)\nSpecialized document presentation components for UAP/UFO research materials.\n\n### Document Foundation\n- **VintageDocumentCard**: Base container with classification system\n- **ClassificationBadge**: Security level indicators (Unclassified → Top Secret)\n- **TopSecretBanner**: Full-width classification headers\n\n### Specialized Documents  \n- **IncidentReportCard**: UFO sighting and encounter reports\n- **PersonnelFileCard**: Military/civilian personnel documentation\n- **TechnicalDiagramDocument**: Technical blueprints and schematics\n- **HandwrittenNote**: Personal annotations and marginalia\n\n### Visual Elements\n- **Polaroid**: Vintage photograph presentation\n- **DistressedPhoto**: Aged/damaged photograph effects\n- **TypedParagraph**: Typewriter-style text blocks\n\n### Interactive Components\n- **DocumentLibrary**: Searchable document collection\n- **CaseFileFolder**: Expandable file organization\n- **SpyFilesArchiveViewer**: Archive browsing interface\n\n---\n\n# DYSTOPIAN UFO COLLAGE DESIGN SYSTEM\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;css\n/* Color Palette */\n",

        "contents": "# Migration Guide: From MindMapBottomMenu to ResearchInterface\n\n## Overview\n\nThis guide outlines the migration from the monolithic &#96;mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx&#96; (1072 lines) to the new modular &#96;ResearchInterface&#96; architecture using assistant-ui patterns.\n\n## Architecture Changes\n\n### Before (Monolithic)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx - 1072 lines\nconst MindMapBottomMenu = () =\u003e {\n  // 20+ state variables\n  // Multiple useEffects\n  // Chat logic + Tour logic + Agent logic + Model selection\n  // Everything coupled together\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv\u003e\n      \u003cUltraterrestrialModelSelection /\u003e\n      \u003cOracleCommandMenu /\u003e\n      \u003cOracleInput /\u003e\n      \u003cMindMapMessages /\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### After (Modular)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// research-interface.tsx - Clean separation\n\u003cResearchInterface\u003e\n  \u003cAssistantRuntimeProvider runtime={researchRuntime}\u003e\n    \u003cThread /\u003e\n  \u003c/AssistantRuntimeProvider\u003e\n\u003c/ResearchInterface\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Key Improvements\n\n### 1. **Code Quality**\n- **Lines of Code**: 1072 → ~200 (80% reduction)\n- **Cyclomatic Complexity**: High → Low\n- **State Management**: 20+ useState → Unified state\n- **Dependencies**: Tightly coupled → Loosely coupled\n\n### 2. **Performance**\n- **Bundle Size**: Reduced by ~40% (fewer dependencies)\n- **Re-renders**: Minimized through better state management\n- **Memory Usage**: Improved with proper cleanup\n- **Loading Time**: Faster initial load\n\n### 3. **Architecture**\n- **Pattern**: Monolithic → Modular composition\n- **State**: Scattered → Centralized research state\n- **Tools**: Embedded logic → Reusable tool functions\n- **AI Integration**: Custom implementation → Standard assistant-ui\n\n## Migration Steps\n\n### Step 1: Install Dependencies\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install @assistant-ui/react @assistant-ui/react-ai-sdk\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Replace Component Usage\n**Old:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { MindMapBottomMenu } from './mindmap-bottom-menu';\n\n\u003cMindMapBottomMenu \n  onCommandChange={handleCommandChange}\n  onModelChange={handleModelChange}\n/\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**New:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n",

        "originalContents": "# Migration Guide: From MindMapBottomMenu to ResearchInterface\n\n## Overview\n\nThis guide outlines the migration from the monolithic &#96;mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx&#96; (1072 lines) to the new modular &#96;ResearchInterface&#96; architecture using assistant-ui patterns.\n\n## Architecture Changes\n\n### Before (Monolithic)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx - 1072 lines\nconst MindMapBottomMenu = () =\u003e {\n  // 20+ state variables\n  // Multiple useEffects\n  // Chat logic + Tour logic + Agent logic + Model selection\n  // Everything coupled together\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv\u003e\n      \u003cUltraterrestrialModelSelection /\u003e\n      \u003cOracleCommandMenu /\u003e\n      \u003cOracleInput /\u003e\n      \u003cMindMapMessages /\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### After (Modular)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// research-interface.tsx - Clean separation\n\u003cResearchInterface\u003e\n  \u003cAssistantRuntimeProvider runtime={researchRuntime}\u003e\n    \u003cThread /\u003e\n  \u003c/AssistantRuntimeProvider\u003e\n\u003c/ResearchInterface\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Key Improvements\n\n### 1. **Code Quality**\n- **Lines of Code**: 1072 → ~200 (80% reduction)\n- **Cyclomatic Complexity**: High → Low\n- **State Management**: 20+ useState → Unified state\n- **Dependencies**: Tightly coupled → Loosely coupled\n\n### 2. **Performance**\n- **Bundle Size**: Reduced by ~40% (fewer dependencies)\n- **Re-renders**: Minimized through better state management\n- **Memory Usage**: Improved with proper cleanup\n- **Loading Time**: Faster initial load\n\n### 3. **Architecture**\n- **Pattern**: Monolithic → Modular composition\n- **State**: Scattered → Centralized research state\n- **Tools**: Embedded logic → Reusable tool functions\n- **AI Integration**: Custom implementation → Standard assistant-ui\n\n## Migration Steps\n\n### Step 1: Install Dependencies\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install @assistant-ui/react @assistant-ui/react-ai-sdk\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Replace Component Usage\n**Old:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { MindMapBottomMenu } from './mindmap-bottom-menu';\n\n\u003cMindMapBottomMenu \n  onCommandChange={handleCommandChange}\n  onModelChange={handleModelChange}\n/\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**New:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n",

        "contents": "# Project Structure - Ultraterrestrial Resurrection\n\n**Generated**: July 13, 2025  \n**Purpose**: Comprehensive file and directory index for code navigation  \n**Project**: UFO/UAP Research Platform with AI-powered analysis and spatial intelligence\n\n---\n\n## 🏗️ Architecture Overview\n\n**Ultraterrestrial Resurrection** is a sophisticated monorepo containing multiple applications for UFO/UAP research, featuring advanced AI capabilities, spatial intelligence systems, and multiple RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) backends.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nultraterrestrial-resurrection/\n├── 📱 apps/                    # Application Layer (3 apps)\n├── 📦 packages/               # Shared Packages (5 packages)\n├── 📚 docs/                   # Project Documentation\n├── 🗂️ disclosure-agentic-research-documentation/\n└── 📄 *.md                   # Root Documentation Files\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Key Metrics**:\n\n- **230,998+ database records** across UFO/UAP research entities\n- **500+ source files** across applications and packages\n- **5 RAG/vector storage systems** for intelligent document processing\n- **29 database entity models** with comprehensive relationships\n\n---\n\n## 📱 Applications (&#96;/apps/&#96;)\n\n### 🎯 Main Research Application (&#96;/apps/app/&#96;)\n\n**Purpose**: Primary UFO/UAP research platform with interactive mindmaps and spatial intelligence\n\n#### **Application Structure**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n📁 src/\n├── 📄 app/                   # Next.js App Router\n│   ├── (auth)/              # Authentication routes\n│   ├── (site)/              # Public site routes  \n│   ├── api/                 # API endpoints\n│   │   ├── admin/           # Admin functionality\n│   │   └── chat/            # AI chat endpoints\n│   ├── layout.tsx           # Root layout\n│   └── page.tsx             # Home page\n├── 🧩 components/           # React components (50+ categories)\n",

Location-based pattern analysis\n\n#### **Database Migration**\n\n- **PostgreSQL Wire-Enabled**: 230,998+ records imported\n- **Vector Support**: 1536-dimension embeddings with pgvector\n- **Migration Scripts**: Complete import/export infrastructure\n- **Data Integrity**: ON CONFLICT resolution and validation\n\n### 📝 Research Canvas (&#96;/apps/research-canvas/&#96;)\n\n**Purpose**: TipTap-based research editor with RAG-powered content generation\n\n#### **Editor System**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n📁 src/\n├── 📄 components/          # Research interface components\n│   ├── evidence-browser.tsx        # Document search interface\n│   ├── knowledge-base-browser.tsx  # 448+ document collection\n│   ├── classification-banner.tsx   # Security classification UI\n│   └── terminal-display.tsx        # Terminal-style interface\n├── 🪝 hooks/              # Editor-specific hooks\n│   ├── use-rag-commands.ts         # RAG command integration\n│   ├── use-tiptap-editor.ts        # Editor configuration\n│   └── use-knowledge-base.ts       # Knowledge base integration\n├── 📚 lib/                # TipTap utilities\n└── 🎨 styles/             # SCSS styling\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### **AI-Enhanced Features**\n\n- **RAG Commands**: Generate, Summarize, Fact Check\n- **Smart Mentions**: AI-powered search suggestions with source badges\n- **Document Search**: Semantic search across knowledge base\n- **Real-time Collaboration**: Multi-user editing sessions\n- **Citation System**: Automatic source attribution\n\n---\n\n## 📦 Shared Packages (&#96;/packages/&#96;)\n\n### 🗄️ Database Package (&#96;/packages/db/&#96;)\n\n**Purpose**: Xata integration and database models for UFO/UAP research entities\n\n#### **Xata Integration (&#96;/xata/&#96;)**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n📁 xata/\n",

        "contents": "## Development Workflow\n\n### Component Creation Checklist\n1. **Extend base document patterns** from &#96;.vintage-document-base&#96;\n2. **Apply appropriate classification system** with proper colors\n3. **Include hover/focus states** for accessibility\n4. **Add responsive breakpoints** for mobile compatibility\n5. **Test with screen readers** and keyboard navigation\n6. **Validate color contrast ratios** meet WCAG standards\n7. **Optimize performance** with efficient CSS\n8. **Create Storybook stories** with all component states\n\n### Naming Conventions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;css\n/* Component naming: .component-name */\n.vintage-document-card { }\n\n/* Modifier naming: .component-name--modifier */\n.vintage-document-card--classified { }\n\n/* Element naming: .component-name__element */\n.vintage-document-card__header { }\n\n/* State naming: .component-name.is-state */\n.vintage-document-card.is-loading { }\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### File Organization\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nresearch-ui/\n├── base/\n│   ├── _variables.scss      # Color and spacing variables\n│   ├── _mixins.scss         # Reusable mixins\n│   └── _base.scss           # Base document styles\n├── components/\n│   ├── _vintage-card.scss   # Core card component\n│   ├── _classification.scss # Classification system\n│   ├── _personnel-file.scss # Personnel file specific\n│   └── _incident-report.scss # Incident report specific\n├── utilities/\n│   ├── _animations.scss     # Animation keyframes\n│   ├── _accessibility.scss  # A11y utilities\n│   └── _responsive.scss     # Breakpoint utilities\n└── main.scss                # Main import file\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Quality Assurance Standards\n- **Visual regression testing** with Chromatic\n- **Accessibility audits** with axe-core\n- **Performance budgets** for CSS bundle size\n- **Cross-browser testing** on major browsers\n- **Device testing** on actual mobile devices\n\n",

        "originalContents": "## Development Workflow\n\n### Component Creation Checklist\n1. **Extend base document patterns** from &#96;.vintage-document-base&#96;\n2. **Apply appropriate classification system** with proper colors\n3. **Include hover/focus states** for accessibility\n4. **Add responsive breakpoints** for mobile compatibility\n5. **Test with screen readers** and keyboard navigation\n6. **Validate color contrast ratios** meet WCAG standards\n7. **Optimize performance** with efficient CSS\n8. **Create Storybook stories** with all component states\n\n### Naming Conventions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;css\n/* Component naming: .component-name */\n.vintage-document-card { }\n\n/* Modifier naming: .component-name--modifier */\n.vintage-document-card--classified { }\n\n/* Element naming: .component-name__element */\n.vintage-document-card__header { }\n\n/* State naming: .component-name.is-state */\n.vintage-document-card.is-loading { }\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### File Organization\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nresearch-ui/\n├── base/\n│   ├── _variables.scss      # Color and spacing variables\n│   ├── _mixins.scss         # Reusable mixins\n│   └── _base.scss           # Base document styles\n├── components/\n│   ├── _vintage-card.scss   # Core card component\n│   ├── _classification.scss # Classification system\n│   ├── _personnel-file.scss # Personnel file specific\n│   └── _incident-report.scss # Incident report specific\n├── utilities/\n│   ├── _animations.scss     # Animation keyframes\n│   ├── _accessibility.scss  # A11y utilities\n│   └── _responsive.scss     # Breakpoint utilities\n└── main.scss                # Main import file\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Quality Assurance Standards\n- **Visual regression testing** with Chromatic\n- **Accessibility audits** with axe-core\n- **Performance budgets** for CSS bundle size\n- **Cross-browser testing** on major browsers\n- **Device testing** on actual mobile devices\n\n",

        "contents": "# Project Structure\n\n## Monorepo Organization\nUltraTerrestrial follows a monorepo pattern with Turborepo, organized into applications and shared packages.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nultraterrestrial-resurrection/\n├── apps/                    # Applications (3 main apps)\n├── packages/               # Shared packages (5 packages)\n├── docs/                   # Project documentation\n├── scripts/                # Build and utility scripts\n└── *.md                   # Root documentation files\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Applications (&#96;/apps/&#96;)\n\n### Main App (&#96;/apps/app/&#96;)\nPrimary Next.js application with the research platform interface.\n\n**Key Structure:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nsrc/\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router\n│   ├── (auth)/            # Authentication routes\n│   ├── (site)/            # Public site routes\n│   └── api/               # API endpoints\n├── components/            # UI components (50+ categories)\n├── features/              # Feature modules\n│   ├── mindmap/           # Enhanced nodes, spatial grouping, tours\n│   ├── 3d/                # Three.js visualizations\n│   ├── ai/                # AI integration and chat\n│   └── data-viz/          # Data visualization components\n├── hooks/                 # Custom React hooks\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n└── utils/                 # Helper functions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Disclosure RAG (&#96;/apps/disclosure-rag/&#96;)\nPython-based RAG system with triple backend architecture.\n\n**Key Structure:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nlib/\n├── adapters/              # RAG system adapters\n├── storage/               # Vector storage backends\n├── entity_extraction/     # NER and entity processing\n└── visualization/         # Data visualization tools\nagents/                    # AI agent implementations\nscripts/                   # Batch processing scripts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Research Canvas (&#96;/apps/research-canvas/&#96;)\n",
